td-3-177.title: The Iron Wheel
td-3-177.text:
Heavy grease coats your knuckles as you grasp the spokes of the manual override. Salt crust flakes off the iron with a dry, papery hiss every time you strain against the jammed spindle. Below your boots, the stilt-city groans in the cold wind blowing off the exposed seabed, vibrating through the metal floor plates like a trapped pulse.

Breathing deep, you plant your heels against the riveted plating and force your weight onto the wheel, praying the rusted chain inside the partition holds firm.

td-3-178.title: A Searing Strain
td-3-178.text:
Iron splinters and rust flakes rain down onto your shoulders as the stubborn mechanism grudgingly gives another quarter-turn. Muscles across your back tighten like overtightened bowstrings, threatening to tear with every inch you claw from the dead weight of the winch. The alcove remains shrouded in absolute shadow just past the rusted bulkhead.

You grit your teeth against the sudden tremor in your forearms, determined to force the pathway open before the chain snaps.

td-3-179.title: The Manual Override
td-3-179.text:
Cold brine cakes the thick iron spokes of the manual winch as you plant your boots against the slick rusted grating of the platform. Below your heels, a three-hundred-foot drop opens into the grey gloom of the seabed, empty and waiting. The jammed cable above groans like a dying beast, refusing to yield an inch of slack unless you put every ounce of muscle and leverage behind the turning wheel. Gritting your teeth against the sudden strain in your back, you heave with all your might against the dead weight of the iron.

Sinews pull taut beneath your skin and the salt-crusted metal bites hard into your calloused palms while the heavy drum shudders beneath the sudden, brutal pressure.

td-3-180.title: Torn Tendons and Rust
td-3-180.text:
A sharp pop echoes inside your shoulder joint, followed by a wave of white-hot agony that robs the breath straight from your lungs. Your grip fails, and you stumble backward against the wet iron railing, clutching your wrenched arm as the override wheel spins violently back into place.

Pain flares with every heartbeat, leaving you weakened and gasping on the cold deck, yet alive enough to press onward through the gloom.

td-3-181.title: The Hidden Alcove
td-3-181.text:
Pain flares through your shoulder with a dull, persistent throb, reminding you how close you came to snapping entirely. However narrowly you managed the strain, the iron bulkhead finally gives way with a heavy, protesting groan, sliding aside to reveal the cramped space within. Resting upon a dusty shelf of oiled canvas sits a small, cold object left behind by some long-forgotten mechanic.

Reach inside and claim the prize.

td-3-182.title: The Desperate Leap
td-3-182.text:
A heavy shadow lunges from behind a support beam, gloved hands slamming hard against your chest to knock you backward toward the open drop. Salty air rushes past your ears as you twist violently at the last fraction of a second, catching the attacker by the collar of their sodden oilskin coat.

The stilt-city walkway sways under the sudden, brutal impact, threatening to send your hard-earned packs tumbling into the empty abyss below.

td-3-183.title: Teeth and Scraps
td-3-183.text:
Fingernails rake across your forearm as the desperate scavenger fights like a cornered dog, snarling curses about water rations and empty pockets. You slam your shoulder into their ribs, driving them back against the freezing iron railing while your canvas packs remain safely strapped to your chest.

The salt-encrusted deck is slick underfoot, turning every movement into a perilous dance above the dead seabed.

td-3-185.title: Bruised and Battered
td-3-185.text:
A vicious blow catches you across the ribs, winding you instantly and forcing you to release your grip as your attacker scrambles away into the shadows. You slump against the cold iron stanchion, gasping for air while checking your gear bags. Several precious items are crushed or lost over the edge, leaving your provisions lighter and your body aching from the violent exchange.

Gather your breath and stand up

td-3-186.title: The Spoils of Scrimmage
td-3-186.text:
The scuffle ends with a sudden, breathless thud as your adversary tumbles away into the gloom, leaving behind a heavy canvas pouch dropped in the rush. However narrowly you survived the brutal push, your supplies remain intact and your grip is firm upon the prize left in the wake of the fight.

Pocket the recovered token of survival.
